report_discrepancies.note: Schedule 6 (p14, not recorded in detail) Adjustment to Budgetary Basis column prints Total non-operating (58,009) but its only printed line is Principal paid (9,921); the (48,088) purchase of capital assets (Exhibit I p9) has no line of its own.

notes: Modified cash basis village audit (FY ended 9/30/2022). Governmental lines from the governmental funds statement, Total Governmental Funds 2022 column (p6; fund columns p5). Taxes 115,276 split by the Schedule 2 Totals column (p11: property 53,295, motor vehicle 11,641, sales 50,340; nonmajor funds have no taxes); Intergovernmental revenues 61,712 split by the same column. Grant income has no grantor printed (category other, detail Grants). Charges for services and refunds counted by the Statement of Activities (p2) as Charges for Services. Insurance proceeds line is 0. Bond principal/interest payments and sale of assets are printed under Other financing sources (uses) and recorded in other_financing. Beginning/ending cash = Exhibit C total assets 2021/2022 (p4: cash in bank + fire hall + county treasurer); fund balances 219,506 / 137,787 from p6. Business-type from the proprietary funds statement (Exhibit H p8; agrees with the Statement of Activities p2: expenses 116,512), modified cash net position measure; receipts total = operating 66,778 + interest 37; disbursements = operating 116,314 + interest/fees 198. Proprietary cash flows from Exhibit I (p9; capital and related = purchase of capital assets (48,088), no net line printed). Balance sheet from the government-wide Statement of Net Position (capital assets and debt present). Detail: Schedule 2 (major funds; Debt Service fund had no activity) and Schedule 4 (nonmajor) per fund; Exhibit H proprietary lines per fund. Schedule 5 (combined budget, fund totals only) and Schedule 6 (proprietary budgetary, same lines as Exhibit H) not recorded to avoid double counting. Read pages 1-14 of 14
